key_insight: Volumetric PTV with Shake-The-Box and high-fidelity LES agree well on the Imperial Front Wing wake, and the study reveals a previously unseen vortex that helps keep the dominant wake structures from merging.
engineering_relevance: The work provides a benchmark dataset and validation path for using volumetric flow measurements and LES in industrial aerodynamics, especially for complex motorsport wakes.
method: Volumetric Particle Tracking Velocimetry (PTV) using Shake-The-Box in the Imperial College 10x5 wind tunnel
Implicit LES of the Imperial Front Wing wake in Nektar++ with spectral h/p elements
Comparison against earlier planar PIV to assess wake topology and vortex dynamics
evidence_signal: At Re=74,896, the measured volumetric wake structure showed good quantitative agreement with the Nektar++ LES results, including identification of a previously unreported vortex.
watch_item: Volumetric PTV is powerful but still sensitive to experimental setup quality, particle tracking performance, and the challenge of validating complex 3D wake structures in industrial environments.
paper_title: Flow behind the Imperial Front Wing: comparison of results from volumetric PTV experiment and Nektar++ simulations
